what: P-418's graded vector for one frame: FR-FIB (B1656's flat fibre frame, B1809 section 4), scored on the six charged-fermion mass ratios on its H-cov, shared-dR branch at B1753's census. A proposal from the web seat; it assigns nothing. Data-free: no measured number is read to build it.
class: the entry is typed by hand from the cited sources; scoreboard_check.py recomputes from main's committed files every menu count it can (the readings, the lines, the apexes and their band, the horocycles, c's scan), checks every other typed item by quoting its source row, and prints the vector (GENERATED)
labels: WORKING_RULES' 2026-10-29 rule, item 4, as amended: FORCED / ADMITTED / CHOSEN for discrete items, FITTED for continuous values set by data; each with scope and evidence. Discrete items selected on the data are 'CHOSEN, on the data'.

discrete.searched_source: the censuses run every one of B1713's 266 lines (B1726, B1741; B1753's census completed to 266 by B1798)
discrete.how: the slope 2/5 is selected by the data, stably out of sample (B1786), 'with one number's worth of input (e_up) - not removed' (MAINS_PLAN); the offset has no rule (P-384); the order-5/10 class was read before B1753's seal (S215, counted in m by B1798 sec. 4). MAINS_PLAN's ledger types the offset as continuous through u = Re w mod 1; here u = alpha Re tau + b mod 1 is fixed by tau and the line, and the offset is counted within the 266

discrete.name: the horocycle
discrete.label: ADMITTED menu (B1667's two canonical radii); the pick CHOSEN, on the data
discrete.options_source: B1667's two canonical end radii, L_max and L_2

discrete.name: the end's regularised scale
discrete.value: the small-cut norm 2 pi L + c_s at L = L_h(Im tau)
discrete.label: CHOSEN, by hand
discrete.options_source: the small-cut norm or the maximal horoball's exact norm (P-421); a binary by definition
discrete.searched_source: fixed by B1726's compute(); not varied on the data
discrete.how: at L_max the exact twisted norms lie 35-38% below the small-cut norm, and with them the six fail near the four families' rows (B1726's dated note; P-421). L is read at Im tau from B1667's Re tau = 1/4 column (B1726's census.py, as B1712-B1725), a hand choice inside this item. If P-421 resolves the scale as an input, this item and the horocycle become one continuous scale, which moves to the continuous component and lifts the bound f(d) <= 2
discrete.since_B1750: added (B1750 typed c_s a convention, 'only 2 pi L + c_s enters')

discrete.name: the Higgs's weight class
discrete.value: 3/2 (the section dR, H-cov's only member there)
discrete.label: CHOSEN, by hand
discrete.options_source: every weight 2n - 1/2; B1691 computed seven, -1/2 to 23/2
discrete.searched_source: not varied in this branch's censuses (B1742's branch uses F6 and F22)
discrete.how: at weight 3/2 H-cov leaves one section, dR, so no section coefficient is free; under the unit alone the weight-3/2 directions form a three-dimensional family and only dR gives a hierarchy (B1700), so the choice was made knowing a hierarchy was needed
discrete.since_B1750: re-typed (split from B1750's 'the Higgs's direction', with the shared section)
